comment: Easy class. You only need an 85% overall to receive an A-. His tests are really hard, but if you read the slides over and over, you will be fine. Do not buy the textbook it's a waste of money. Also, he does NOT give a notes paper with his exams anymore, so they're a lot harder.
This guy is a BEAST. Take him if you can. Not hard to get a good grade.

nice person and will help outside of class. but lectures and materials are generally confusing and he flies through the material. you have to work for the grade. only graded assignments are four tests so get ready to study hard.

generally a nice guy but I swear he's bipolar. One minute he's yelling at us the next he's cracking jokes. Homework is all up to you, not mandatory, but you need to do it to do well. 4 tests throughout the semester, final not cumulative. Every test has 2 parts, MC and short answer. NO Partial credit. Willing to meet for extra help. Average overall.

Overall very easy class. Gives 3 tests all 35 multiple choice. Allows you to correct tests the following class period for partial credit. Additonally, two assignments (innovation project and ethical leadership essay) that are hard to get less than 100% on. Final given in class as a normal test on the last 3 chapters of textbook. Very funny as well.
Classes are not demanding, although his lectures can be confusing... Does not actually teach anything. Test are not hard.
AIS is a class where you can learn some things that will actually be put to use in accounting. It would have been nice to learn that stuff.
Very unclear, unfair grader.  Gives a ridiculous amount of work, and leaves half the class clueless. Avoid taking him for AIS, ok for managerial.

The online stuff was pretty easy and helped you in class if you actually tried on it.  His in class examples were a little hard to understand and he was a bit all over the place in terms of lecturing but he was always available to help outside of class if you needed it.  Nice guy but you need to work semi hard for an A. Tests are tricky.

Financial Acct - really great guy. He is fun in class and makes an effort to get to know his students. A lot of online homework/quizzes, discussion questions due for each chapter, and 3 multiple choice tests. The tests are only 40 points so its hard to do well but if you do the final is optional.

I took Selby for Financial Accounting.  He is the man.  He is not hard, crystal clear, and very fair.  If you do the work, you will do very well. There are no curves, but that has not been an issue as you can easily prepare for the tests.  Great teacher, great class

Selby is the absolute man. Teaching style keeps you constantly engaged and involved, even when the material is pretty brutal. Listen to what he says, read the material, stay on top of the assignments, and this class is a comfortable A/B.

Dr. Selby is a fantastic teacher and has made a topic which I would have previously guessed as bland and made it one of the most interesting classes I've taken so far. He really makes you learn the material, but in a good way. Awesome teacher. Take him.
Selby is awesome. He's always willing to help you and answer questions. Always make sure you're prepared for class, because he will randomly call on you. Really knows financial accounting.
Great professor, friendly. Clear explanations, and good examples. He lets you bring a two page sheet with notes to the exams. Post-tests and one HW exercise due every week only. Reaally easy...
